result.summary: The intersection includes basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, a marked crosswalk, and pedestrian signals. However, the crossing markings are standard parallel lines rather than high-visibility patterns, and mature trees and utility poles may create minor sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Utility poles and mature trees at the corner may partially obscure the view of pedestrians waiting to cross for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner near the signal pole.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The parallel line crosswalk markings are somewhat worn, reducing their visibility to motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Crossing the side street on the right.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard parallel line markings with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection that is heavily prioritized for vehicular traffic and lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or refuge islands, forcing pedestrians to cross a significant distance unprotected.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide, multi-lane arterial without any painted markings to alert drivers to their presence.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated walk/don't-walk signals for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians in the path of high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style crosswalk markings on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide dedicated crossing phases.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
